strongest_angle: Exploring the centuries-old mathematical challenge of flattening a 3D sphere into a 2D surface, highlighted by the United Nations' recent resolution urging organizations to move away from the Mercator projection.

key_facts.fact: On September 4, 2026, the United Nations adopted a resolution encouraging governments, schools, and organizations to replace the Mercator projection.
Member States endorsed a resolution promoting map projections by 164 votes to one on Friday, September 4, 2026.
Greenland's size relative to other land areas corresponds to less than one-tenth that of Africa.
